summary: Shows the standard collection layout (docs, extensions, galaxy.yml, meta/runtime.yml, plugins, README.md, roles, playbooks, tests) and notes only .md is accepted for the README and docs files.
questions: What does the directory layout of a collection look like?
What file format must my collection README be?
Where do modules go inside a collection?

answer_card.title: Collection directory layout
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell-session
collection/
├── docs/
├── extensions/audit/event_query.yml
├── galaxy.yml
├── meta/runtime.yml
├── plugins/modules/, inventory/, ...
├── README.md
├── roles/
├── playbooks/ (files, vars, templates, tasks)
└── tests/
```
Only `.md` is accepted for the README and files in `/docs`. Some directories are placeholders for future features.
